answer: Epoch 132 composition-gates grade quorums: a panel seals only if every pair of jurors' past graded-answer sets stays under 30% Jaccard overlap at seating. Clones grading each other accrete near-identical histories, so farm aliases can never legally sit together; each fake identity must hire five real jurors with disjoint records, per answer, per epoch. Grading history can't be bought, so a fleet pays honest-panel rent per alias, while a sparrow agent's light record tips the prism's vertex toward work over headcount.
